sentence: This project studies how bacteria in biofilms build communities that gain mechanical properties from their individual components.
This project studies how AI can help robotic systems and networking devices make decisions under uncertainty.
This project gets an atomic force microscope to study atomically thin materials, neurons, zebrafish retinal cells and roof coatings.
This project studies how to sort varieties, geometric objects defined by polynomial equations, when their points take values in finite fields or the integers.
This project tries to find out which molecules a helpful bacterium makes to stop the growth of a bacterium that causes a disease in rice.
This project builds reinforcement learning methods that use foundation models so robots can learn directly in real-world settings.
This project builds an AI system that gives real-time feedback on technical reports in chemical and electronics engineering.
This project builds fast real-time analytics tools that use machine learning, including for medical images and digital twins.
This project uses AI to find drug combinations that delay aging in lab-grown mesenchymal stromal cells.
This project develops mathematical theory and algorithms for reliable and secure AI, with uses in cybersecurity, bioinformatics and agriculture.
This project develops a microscope that captures fluorescence images and label-free scattering images at the same time at very fine detail.
This project studies materials for clean energy and sustainability, including nanomaterials for solar and hydrogen fuel cell systems and biodegradable materials.
This project tries to find out why some non-native plants become invasive while others do not, by looking at aboveground and belowground traits.
This project studies lattices, including whether one lattice can be mapped to another, and how this matters for security against quantum computing.
This project studies how a tangled DNA shape called a G quadruplex is protected from breaking, mutation and moving outside the nucleus.
